fusions.name: Rust Spit
fusions.desc: Spits a gob of rust-water that deals 4 damage, with a 25% chance to leave the target [Sundered] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Sudden Snap
fusions.desc: Springs at a wounded enemy and deals 18 damage, consuming every affliction on it to add 1.5 times their remaining damage to the hit. Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health.

fusions.name: Leap Into Brace
fusions.desc: Springs you 3 tiles and raises your armour by 20% for 10 seconds. Enemies more than 3 tiles away lose track of you.

fusions.name: Coiled Under Plate
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 6. When you reach 6, they all spend at once: you move and attack 3% faster per stack (16% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds. Your armour rises by 5%.
